tool.name: ATACseqQC TSSE
tool.description: Computes Transcription Start Site Enrichment Score

configfiles.configfile: library(ATACseqQC) library(rtracklayer) library(Rsamtools) bamfile <- '$inputbam' gtf <- import.gff('$gtf') seqlengths_from_bam <- scanBamHeader(bamfile)[[1]]\$targets #if $region_cond.region == 'first': which <- GRanges(seqnames= names(seqlengths_from_bam)[1], ranges=IRanges(start = 1, end = seqlengths_from_bam[1])) #elif $region_cond.region == 'GW': which <- GRanges(seqnames= names(seqlengths_from_bam), ranges=IRanges(start = 1, end = seqlengths_from_bam)) #else: stopifnot("choosen chromosome is not part of the BAM"='$region_cond.chromosome' %in% names(seqlengths_from_bam)) which <- GRanges(seqnames= '$region_cond.chromosome', ranges=IRanges(start = 1, end = seqlengths_from_bam['$region_cond.chromosome'])) #end if # Here I consider the BAM file as single-read as the paired info is not used. # As the bin sizes for the TSSE are relatively large the shift of 5bp is unnecessary. gal <- readBamFile(bamfile, which=which, bigFile=TRUE) # Subset the gtf gtf_sub <- subsetByOverlaps(gtf, which) if ('transcript' %in% gtf_sub\$type) { txs <- subset(gtf_sub, type == "transcript") } else { # Aggregate exons to transcripts if (! 'transcript_id' %in% mcols(gtf_sub)) { stop("The gtf contains no transcript and the transcript_id is not part of attributes. This gtf cannot be used for this tool.") } gtf_sub_exons <- subset(gtf_sub, type == "exon") txs <- unlist(range(GenomicRanges::split(gtf_sub_exons, gtf_sub_exons\$transcript_id))) names(txs) <- NULL } # Will be exposed one day maybe: updown <- 1000 endSize <- 100 width <- 100 step <- 100 tsse <- TSSEscore(gal, txs, upstream = updown, downstream = updown, endSize = endSize, width = width, step = step) x_values <- seq(- updown + width / 2, updown - width / 2, step) png("tsse_plot.png") plot(x_values, tsse\$values, type = "b", xlab = "distance to TSS", ylab = "aggregate TSS score", main = paste("TSSEscore:", tsse\$TSSEscore)) dev.off() #if '$output_selector.tssevalues': write.table(data.frame(x = x_values, v = tsse\$values), "tsse_values.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE) #end if #if '$output_selector.tssescore': cat(tsse\$TSSEscore, file = "tsse_score.txt") #end if

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
This tool is a wrapper for the TSSEscore function of the `ATACseqQC bioconductor package <https://github.com/jianhong/ATACseqQC/>`_.
It aggregates coverage of the BAM around all TSS of the given GTF file and normalizes it to the coverage on the flank regions. On ATAC-seq, we expect an enrichment around TSS and therefore expect a higher coverage at the TSS position than at the flank regions. Additionally the tool computes a TSS enrichment score based on a loess.smooth of the profile.
Usage .....
**Input**
- A BAM file from ATAC-seq or any other experiment for which you want to evaluate a TSS enrichment. - A GTF file matching the genome you used for your alignment.
**Output**
The main output is a plot with the average normalized coverage around TSS but the user can add more outputs like the TSSEscore value in a file and/or all the values of the average normalized coverage.
